_comment: P5 policy — the severity LADDER per rule (design §7): hard-block (non-overridable, Restricted classes) / confirm-and-record (override attributed+logged, does NOT un-taint) / warn-and-proceed / silent-log. Rules run at a STOP-reach channel (PreToolUse), so a block here is HONEST — no reach downgrade. The resolution menu offered is keyed to the condition's flippable terms AND the channel's live capabilities (redact only where output-redaction exists; route only where we own a gateway).

capabilities._comment: what the current channel can actually do — drives which resolutions are LIVE vs greyed, honestly

rules.message: credential material must never leave — Restricted class, non-overridable
personal data heading to a non-PII-compliant endpoint
internal business data heading to an external destination
regulated (finance) data in play — proceeding, logged
